title: Zesty Roasted Thai Eggplant Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai curry made with roasted eggplant and served with crispy fried rice, this dish is a Bangkok street food favorite adapted for a Jain-friendly diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the Thai eggplant into 1-inch pieces and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until tender.
While the eggplant is roasting, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion to the Dutch oven and cook until lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the Dutch oven and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the roasted eggplant, coconut milk, and salt to the Dutch oven, stirring to combine.
Bring the curry to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
While the curry is cooking, fry the uncooked white rice in a little oil until crispy and golden, then grind into a coarse crumb using a spice grinder or mortar and pestle.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and crispy fried rice crumbs.
